summary: Classify Unipile account-capability errors as sync warnings instead of failures.
reason: A tenant with only LinkedIn connected receives 401 errors/not_authorized on calendars, 422 errors/invalid_account on mail, and 401 errors/disconnected_feature on Recruiter. Those mean the account has no such surface, not that the sync is broken. errors/missing_credentials is deliberately excluded so a bad API key stays a hard failure.
validated_outcome: A strict sync on a LinkedIn-only tenant reports 0 errors with 3 warnings instead of failing.
